verdict.rationale: Google Cloud documents a first-party IaC service, Infrastructure Manager, which lets you define infrastructure declaratively with Terraform. It also offers preview deployments, but a preview is a dry-run of changes, not state management or rollback. The evidence shows no typed CDK-style framework and no documented state or rollback semantics, so only the templates part of the story is covered. Missing for 10: a typed CDK-style first-party framework, documented state management and rollback semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, infrastructure is code on day one — a first-party IaC surface (templates plus a typed CDK-style framework) with documented state/rollback semantics

citations.quote: Define your infrastructure declaratively using Terraform.
Create preview deployments to see how changes affect your infrastructure before applying them.
